title: It is not round, it is the tree! 🌲
text: It is not round, it is the tree! 🌲. Dissatisfied. Even though a round ornament is shown, it is a tree you get, and it says that in the heading it is a tree. So if you want the tree it is nice. I didn’t. I wanted the round one as pictured. I was looking at the picture rather than the description. So when it arrived I was confused. As I read the description, I noticed my mistake. So check that before you order.
